title: Simba JDBC Driver (Legacy) 2.8.7 is available
body: Simba JDBC Driver (Legacy) 2.8.7 updates `jackson-core`, `jackson-databind`, and `jackson-datatype-jsr310` to 2.21.8. Download it from the [JDBC drivers archive](https://www.databricks.com/spark/jdbc-drivers-archive) under **All JDBC Driver Versions (Simba)**.
